44943-harper-s-young-people-march-1-1881.creator: Unknown
44943-harper-s-young-people-march-1-1881.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Among the listeners to the gospel Paul had preached, among the wondering spectators of the lame man's healing, among the on-lookers at the deed of violence, stands a boy, generous and warm-hearted, weeping manly tears over that which is done.

arxiv-2012-15707.title: Abelian envelopes of exact categories and highest weight categories
arxiv-2012-15707.creator: Agnieszka Bodzenta, Alexey Bondal
arxiv-2012-15707.description: Abstract . We define admissible and weakly admissible subcategories in exact categories and prove that the former induce semi-orthogonal decompositions on the derived categories. We develop the theory of thin exact categories, an exact-category analogue of triangulated categories generated by exceptional sequences.

arxiv-2101-08155.title: On the Readability of Abstract Set Visualizations
arxiv-2101-08155.creator: Markus Wallinger, Ben Jacobsen, Stephen Kobourov, and Martin Nöllenburg
arxiv-2101-08155.description: Abstract Set systems are used to model data that naturally arises in many contexts: social networks have communities, musicians have genres, and patients have symptoms. Visualizations that accurately reflect the information in the underlying set system make it possible to identify the set elements, the sets themselves, and the relationships between the sets.

arxiv-2102-02363.title: Operational Semantics with Hierarchical Abstract Syntax Graphs Extended abstract of invited talk
arxiv-2102-02363.creator: Dan R. Ghica
arxiv-2102-02363.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Dan R. Ghica. This is a motivating tutorial introduction to a semantic analysis of programming languages using a graphical language as the representation of terms, and graph rewriting as a representation of reduction rules. We show how the graphical language automatically incorporates desirable features, such as α \alpha -equivalence and how it can describe pure computation, imperative store, and control features in a uniform framework.

arxiv-2103-04463.title: Stable Energy Distribution of Weakly Dissipative Gasses under Collisional Energy Cascades
arxiv-2103-04463.creator: Keisuke Fujii, Jun Imano, Arseniy Kuzmin, Taiichi Shikama, Masahiro Hasuo
arxiv-2103-04463.description: Abstract Collisional thermalization of a particle ensemble under the energy dissipation can be seen in variety of systems, such as heated granular gasses and particles in plasmas. Despite its universal existence, analytical descriptions of the steady-state distribution have been missing.

arxiv-2110-08210.title: Comment on “Flavor invariants and renormalization- group equations in the leptonic sector with massive Majorana neutrinos” arXiv: 2110.08210
arxiv-2110-08210.creator: Jianlong Lu
arxiv-2110-08210.description: Abstract Recently in [ JHEP 09 (2021) 053], Wang et al. discussed the polynomial ring formed by flavor invariants in the leptonic sector with massive Majorana neutrinos. They have explicitly constructed the finite generating sets of the polynomial rings for both two-generation scenario and three-generation scenario. However, Wang et al.

arxiv-2205-01638.title: Asymptotic Independence of the Sum and Maximum of Dependent Random Variables with Applications to High-Dimensional Tests Thanks: Corresponding author.
arxiv-2205-01638.creator: Long Feng
arxiv-2205-01638.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Long Feng. For a set of dependent random variables, without stationary or the strong mixing assumptions, we derive the asymptotic independence between their sums and maxima. Then we apply this result to high-dimensional testing problems, where we combine the sum-type and max-type tests and propose a novel test procedure for the one-sample mean test, the two-sample mean test and the regression coefficient test in high-dimensional setting. Based on the asymptotic independence between sums and maxima, the asymptotic distributions of test statistics are established.

arxiv-2302-07506.title: Superradiant phase transition induced by the indirect Rabi interaction
arxiv-2302-07506.creator: Wen Huang, Ying Wu, Xin-You Lü
arxiv-2302-07506.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Wen Huang, Ying Wu, Xin-You Lü. We theoretically study the superradiant phase transition (SPT) in an indirect Rabi model, where both a two-level system and a single mode bosonic field couple to an auxiliary bosonic field. We find that the indirect spin-field coupling induced by the virtual excitation of the auxiliary field can allow the occurrence of a SPT at a critical point, and the influence of the so-called A 2 A^{2} term in the normal Rabi model is naturally avoided.

arxiv-2306-16049.title: What Sentiment and Fun Facts We Learnt Before FIFA World Cup Qatar 2022 Using Twitter and AI
arxiv-2306-16049.creator: James She 2 , Kamilla Swart-Arries 2 , Mohammad Belal 2 and Simon Wong 4
arxiv-2306-16049.description: Abstract Twitter is a social media platform bridging most countries and allows real-time news discovery. Since the tweets on Twitter are usually short and express public feelings, thus provide a source for opinion mining and sentiment analysis for global events. This paper proposed an effective solution, in providing a sentiment on tweets related to the FIFA World Cup.

arxiv-2308-03122.title: “Kurosawa”: A Script Writer’s Assistant
arxiv-2308-03122.creator: Prerak Gandhi, Vishal Pramanik, Pushpak BhattacharyyaDepartment of Computer Science and EngineeringIndian Institute of Technology Bombay, Mumbai {prerakgandhi,vishalpramanik,pb}@cse.iitb.ac.in
arxiv-2308-03122.description: Abstract Storytelling is the lifeline of the entertainment industry- movies, TV shows, and stand-up comedies, all need stories. A good and gripping script is the lifeline of storytelling and demands creativity and resource investment. Good scriptwriters are rare to find and often work under severe time pressure. Consequently, entertainment media are actively looking for automation.

arxiv-2308-06367.title: Achieving Strong Magnon Blockade through Magnon Squeezing in a Cavity Magnetomechanical System
arxiv-2308-06367.creator: M. Amazioug, D. S. Dutykh, B. Teklu, M. Asjad
arxiv-2308-06367.description: Abstract We propose a scheme to achieve magnon (photon) blockade by using magnon squeezing within a cavity magnomechanical system under weak pump driving. Under ideal conditions, we observe a substantial magnon blockade effect, as well as simultaneous photon blockade. Moreover, both numerical and analytical results match perfectly, providing robust evidence of consistency.

arxiv-2312-01899.creator: G. Russano, V. Andretta, Y. De Leo, L. Teriaca, M. Uslenghi, S. Giordano, D. Telloni, P. Heinzel, S. Jejčič, L. Abbo, A. Bemporad, A. Burtovoi, G. E. Capuano, F. arxiv-2402-12363.title: Emergent Word Order Universals from Cognitively-Motivated Language Models
arxiv-2402-12363.creator: Tatsuki Kuribayashi Ryo Ueda Ryo Yoshida Yohei Oseki, Ted Briscoe Timothy Baldwin
arxiv-2402-12363.description: Abstract The world’s languages exhibit certain so-called typological or implicational universals; for example, Subject-Object-Verb (SOV) languages typically use postpositions. Explaining the source of such biases is a key goal of linguistics. We study word-order universals through a computational simulation with language models (LMs).

arxiv-2404-05017.title: A variety of co-quasivarieties Thanks: Partially supported by Centro de Matemática da Universidade de Coimbra (CMUC), funded by the Portuguese Government through FCT/MCTES, DOI 10.54499/UIDB/00324/2020. Thanks: Partially supported by Centro de Matemática da Universidade de Coimbra (CMUC), funded by
arxiv-2404-05017.creator: Maria Manuel Clementino, Carlos Fitas, Dirk Hofmann
arxiv-2404-05017.description: Abstract . It is shown that the duals of several categories of topological flavour, like the categories of ordered sets, generalised metric spaces, probabilistic metric spaces, topological spaces, approach spaces, are quasivarieties, presenting a common proof for all such results.

arxiv-2405-14924.title: Upper tail large deviations of the directed landscape
arxiv-2405-14924.creator: Sayan Das, Duncan Dauvergne, Bálint Virág
arxiv-2405-14924.description: Abstract Starting from one-point tail bounds, we establish an upper tail large deviation principle for the directed landscape at the metric level. Metrics of finite rate are in one-to-one correspondence with measures supported on a set of countably many paths, and the rate function is given by a certain Kruzhkov entropy of these measures.

arxiv-2406-09028.title: From Biased to Unbiased Dynamics: An Infinitesimal Generator Approach
arxiv-2406-09028.creator: Timothée Devergne, Vladimir R. Kostic, Michele Parrinello, Massimiliano Pontil
arxiv-2406-09028.description: Abstract We investigate learning the eigenfunctions of evolution operators for time-reversal invariant stochastic processes, a prime example being the Langevin equation used in molecular dynamics. Many physical or chemical processes described by this equation involve transitions between metastable states separated by high potential barriers that can hardly be crossed during a simulation.

arxiv-2411-01136.title: Do LLMs Know to Respect Copyright Notice?
arxiv-2411-01136.creator: Jialiang Xu, Shenglan Li, Zhaozhuo Xu, Denghui Zhang
arxiv-2411-01136.description: Abstract Prior study shows that LLMs sometimes generate content that violates copyright. In this paper, we study another important yet underexplored problem, i.e., will LLMs respect copyright information in user input, and behave accordingly? The research problem is critical, as a negative answer would imply that LLMs will become the primary facilitator and accelerator of copyright infringement behavior.

arxiv-2502-01223.title: The cold neutral medium in filaments at high Galactic latitudes
arxiv-2502-01223.creator: P. M. W. Kalberla
arxiv-2502-01223.description: Abstract Context. The H i distribution at high Galactic latitudes has been found to be filamentary and closely related to the far infrared (FIR) in caustics with coherent velocity structures. These structures trace the orientation of magnetic field lines. Aims.

arxiv-2505-04137.title: optHIM: Hybrid Iterative Methods for Continuous Optimization in PyTorch
arxiv-2505-04137.creator: Nikhil Sridhar and Sajiv Shah
arxiv-2505-04137.description: Abstract We introduce optHIM , an open-source library of continuous unconstrained optimization algorithms implemented in PyTorch for both CPU and GPU. By leveraging PyTorch’s autograd, optHIM seamlessly integrates function, gradient, and Hessian information into flexible line search and trust region methods. We evaluate eleven state-of-the-art variants on benchmark problems spanning convex and non-convex landscapes.

arxiv-2508-12355.title: Consensus or Conflict? Fine-Grained Evaluation of Conflicting Answers in Question-Answering
arxiv-2508-12355.creator: Eviatar Nachshoni, Arie Cattan, Shmuel Amar, Ori Shapira, Ido Dagan
arxiv-2508-12355.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in question answering (QA) tasks. However, Multi-Answer Question Answering (MAQA), where a question may have several valid answers, remains challenging. Traditional QA settings often assume consistency across evidences, but MAQA can involve conflicting answers.

arxiv-2509-17663.title: Vectorial Light in Fabry-Pérot Resonators in the Normal Dispersion Regime
arxiv-2509-17663.creator: Graeme N. Campbell 1,2, Lewis Hill 2, Pascal Del’Haye 2,3, Gian-Luca Oppo 1
arxiv-2509-17663.description: Abstract The ranges of existence and stability of dark cavity-soliton stationary states in a Fabry-Pérot resonator with a Kerr nonlinear medium, vectorial polarization components and normal dispersion are determined. The Fabry-Pérot configuration introduces nonlocal coupling that shifts the cavity detuning by the round trip average power of the intracavity field.

arxiv-2601-06363.title: The Replicator-Optimization Mechanism: A Scale-Relative Formalism for Persistence-Conditioned Dynamics with Application to Consent-Based Metaethics
arxiv-2601-06363.creator: Murad Farzulla, [0.3em] King’s College London Dissensus AI [0.3em] ORCID: 0009-0002-7164-8704
arxiv-2601-06363.description: Abstract This paper formalizes a widely used dynamical class—replicator-mutator dynamics and Price-style selection-and-transmission—and makes explicit the modeling choices (scale, atomic unit, interaction topology, transmission kernel) that determine how this class instantiates across domains. The backbone is known; we do not claim to have discovered selection.

doe-osti-3015564-application-of-sammy-fo.creator: Leal, Luiz, Zhang, Chen, Zavorka, Lukas et al.

This report presents the application of SAMMY (Larson 2008), an R-matrix Bayesian fitting system, for analyzing neutron transmission data to enable non-destructive isotopic identification. Transmission measurements were conducted at the VENUS (Bilheux et al. 2023) beamline of the

europmc-pmc6711459.title: A guide to group effective connectivity analysis, part 1: First level analysis with DCM for fMRI.
europmc-pmc6711459.creator: Zeidman P, Jafarian A, Corbin N, Seghier ML, Razi A, Price CJ, Friston KJ.
europmc-pmc6711459.description: Dynamic Causal Modelling (DCM) is the predominant method for inferring effective connectivity from neuroimaging data. In the 15 years since its introduction, the neural models and statistical routines in DCM have developed in parallel, driven by the needs of researchers in...

pmc-10565131.title: Retinopathy among women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy attending hospitals in Mbarara city, south-western Uganda: a cross-sectional study
pmc-10565131.creator: Ibrahimu Zamaladi, Sam Ruvuma, Carmel M Mceniery, Teddy Kwaga, Ian B Wilkinson, Daniel Atwine, Henry Mark Lugobe
pmc-10565131.description: ObjectiveRetinopathy is one of the complications occurring among women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy. We sought to determine the prevalence and factors associated with retinopathy among women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy in southwestern Uganda.DesignThis was a hospital-based cross-sectional study from November 2019 to March 2020.SettingThree selected hospitals in Mbarara city, south-western Uganda.

pmc-11585341.title: Aspirin but not statins is inversely related to gastric cancer with a duration–risk effect: Results from the Stomach Cancer Pooling Project Consortium
pmc-11585341.creator: Roberta Pastorino, Denise Pires Marafon, Michele Sassano, Ilda Hoxhaj, Claudio Pelucchi, Linda M Liao, Charles S Rabkin, Rashmi Sinha, Nuno Lunet, Samantha Morais, David Zaridze, Dmitry Maximovich, Nuria Aragonés, Gemma Castaño‐Vinyals, Inés Gómez‐Acebo, Lizbeth López‐Carrillo, Malaquias López‐Cerva
pmc-11585341.description: BackgroundAspirin and statins have been suggested to have potential chemopreventive effects against gastric cancer (GC), although the results of previous studies have been inconsistent. This study therefore aimed to investigate the association between the use of aspirin and statins and GC.

pmc-11596428.title: The Interplay of Core Diameter and Diameter Ratio on the Magnetic Properties of Bistable Glass-Coated Microwires
pmc-11596428.creator: Valeria Kolesnikova, Irina Baraban, Alexander Omelyanchik, Larissa Panina, Valeria Rodionova, Seung-bok Choi
pmc-11596428.description: Glass-coated microwires exhibiting magnetic bistability have garnered significant attention as promising wireless sensing elements, primarily due to their rapid magnetization switching capabilities. These microwires consist of a metallic core with diameter d, encased in a glass coating, with a total diameter D.

pmc-11688251.title: Neuromonitoring modalities predicting neurological impairment in pediatric congenital heart disease: a systematic review
pmc-11688251.creator: Liselotte Van Loo, Bjorn Cools, Anneleen Dereymaeker, Katrien Jansen
pmc-11688251.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The increased risk of neurodevelopmental impairment in children with congenital heart disease (CHD) has been established, but the search for targeted neurological predictors of adverse outcome is ongoing. This systematic review reports on the utility of three functional neuromonitoring modalities, Near-infrared Spectroscopy (NIRS), electroencephalography (EEG) and biochemical biomarkers, in predicting either clinical neurodevelopmental outcome or structural brain abnormalities after pediatric CHD surgery. Medline, Embase, CENTRAL, Web of Science, clinicaltrials.gov and ICTRP were systematically searched for eligible articles.

pmc-12362620.title: Cell-free DNA in extracellular vesicles: A candidate biomarker of schizophrenia
pmc-12362620.creator: Yu-Long Bai, Shi-Fa Ma, Dong-Dong Qi, Chuang Guo, Peng Liu, Kuan-Jun He
pmc-12362620.description: Schizophrenia (SCZ) is a severe mental disorder with significant impacts on individuals, families, and society. Previous research has indicated that SCZ patients will commonly face substantial impairments in mitochondrial function and oxidative phosphorylation in the brain. Cell-free DNA (cf-DNA), serving as a direct biomarker of apoptosis, offers a valuable vantage point to understand the complex cellular mechanisms underlying SCZ.

pmc-12565920.title: Different Temperature Storage Conditions and Packaging Types Affects Colour Parameters, Amino Acid Composition, Microbial Contamination, and Key Bioactive Molecules of Moringa oleifera Lam. Powder
pmc-12565920.creator: Ashwell R Ndhlala, Gladness T Ngobeni, Rofhiwa Mulaudzi, Sogolo L Lebelo, Sabina Lachowicz-Wiśniewska
pmc-12565920.description: Moringa oleifera, renowned for its medicinal potency, was investigated to discern the impact of varying storage temperatures (4 °C, 25 °C, 40 °C) and light conditions (dark and light) on the quality attributes of its leaf powder during a 12-month storage period.

pmc-12705285.title: Gold nanoparticle based fluorescent aptasensors: A chemical and biological detection perspective
pmc-12705285.creator: Zahra Hashemi, Tayebeh Hashemi, Azam Samadi, Elaheh Rahimpour
pmc-12705285.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Introduction: In recent decades, the development of simple and reliable techniques for detecting chemical and biological molecules has gained considerable importance. These methods have found extensive applications in different fields, including medicine, biotechnology, food safety, and environmental monitoring. Among these, aptasensors have attracted significant attention owing to their exceptional selectivity, high sensitivity, and versatility in targeting a wide range of analytes. Integrating aptasensors with nanotechnology, particularly gold nanoparticles (Au NPs), has revolutionized the efficiency and performance of these devices.

pmc-13122739.title: Maternal Obesity Programs Adipogenic Commitment in Neonatal Mesenchymal Stem Cells: A Link to Redox‐Dependent FOXO1 Signaling
pmc-13122739.creator: Sofía Bellalta, Erika Pinheiro‐Machado, Theo Borghuis, Jelmer Prins, Torsten Plösch, Paola Casanello, Marijke Faas
pmc-13122739.description: Maternal obesity increases the risk of obesity and metabolic disease in the offspring, yet the cellular mechanisms that program adipose tissue development remain poorly understood. Mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs), the precursors of adipocytes, may represent an early target of metabolic programming during fetal development.

pmc-13132411.title: This is ‘offside’: Gambling advertising during Czech football broadcasts
pmc-13132411.creator: Filip Kovařík, David Fiedor, Steve Sharman
pmc-13132411.description: Background and AimsGambling advertising during sports broadcasts has received increasing academic attention, although research has primarily focused on the United Kingdom context. This study addresses this geographical limitation by conducting a comprehensive content analysis of gambling advertising during football broadcasts in the Czech Republic.

pmc-13183965.title: Macular degeneration collection
pmc-13183965.creator: Masahiro Miura, Matt Trinh, Juan E Gallo, Xinhua Shu
pmc-13183965.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Age-related macular degeneration (AMD) remains a leading cause of severe vision loss among the older adults in developed countries. Improving patient outcomes is dependent on elucidating the complex pathogenesis of the disease and refining clinical and therapeutic strategies. This Collection showcases a diverse range of papers exploring the frontiers of imaging-based prediction, treatment optimization, mechanistic biology, and the assessment of visual function.

pmc-13222608.title: Nanocarrier-Enabled Melittin Therapy: Mechanistic Advances, Therapeutic Applications, and Translational Challenges
pmc-13222608.creator: Yuezhihong Xiong, Huili Cai, Siyu Jia, Boya Gong, Kairong Hou, Hongyan Wu, Haidan Chen
pmc-13222608.description: Melittin, a 26-amino-acid amphipathic peptide derived from bee venom, has attracted sustained interest in nanomedicine because of its broad anticancer, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory activities. These effects arise not only from direct membrane disruption, but also from secondary intracellular stress signaling and context-dependent immunomodulatory responses.

pmc-13520470.title: Surface Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy of Planetary Materials Using Laser Deposited Plasmonic Gold Nanoparticles
pmc-13520470.creator: Atchutananda Surampudi, David Tuschel, Tilak Hewagama, Shahid Aslam, Dina Bower, Anil Aryal, Felix Jaetae Seo, Narasimha Prasad, Mool C. Gupta
pmc-13520470.description: Detection of trace materials on planetary surfaces and changes to the surface composition or structural modifications is important for identifying contaminants and other near-surface changes that may contain valuable geological information. This work demonstrates a surface-enhanced raman spectroscopy (SERS) approach based on laser deposition of Au plasmonic nanoparticles onto several relevant mineral surfaces.

pmc-13594392.title: Assessing Collaborative Learning Profiles in Nursing and Medical Students: Preliminary Development and Exploratory Validation of the Attitudes Toward Collaborative Learning Scale
pmc-13594392.creator: Shih‐Tzu Huang, Mei‐Chen Kuo, Yu‐Min Huang, Chiou‐Fang Liou
pmc-13594392.description: AimsTo develop and preliminarily validate the Attitudes Toward Collaborative Learning Scale (ATCLS) and characterize profiles of collaborative learning attitudes among nursing and medical students.DesignAn exploratory cross‐sectional quantitative study.Review MethodsParticipants completed the ATCLS. Reliability and construct validity were evaluated using internal consistency and confirmatory factor analysis. Separate hierarchical and K‐means cluster analyses were conducted for nursing and medical students.
